question: Editor of a Marathi newspaper “Kesari” was ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bal Gangadhar Tilak.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak **was a prominent Indian **nationalist leader, social reformer, and freedom fighter** who played a key role in the Indian Independence Movement.
 
• He was also a journalist and founded two newspapers,** Kesari in Marathi **and **Mahratta in English**, to spread awareness among the masses and promote **nationalistic ideas. ​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bipin Chandra Pal** was an **Indian nationalist, journalist, and freedom fighter** who was one of the leaders of the Indian Independence Movement.

 
 
• He was also a founder of the newspaper, **"Bande Mataram."**
 
 
 
• **Aurobindo Ghosh **was an Indian **philosopher, nationalist, and yogi** who contributed significantly to the Indian Independence Movement.
 
 
• He was also a prolific writer and founded the journal, **"Karmayogin."**
 
 
 
• **Lala Lajpat Rai** was an Indian **nationalist leader** who played a key role in the Indian Independence Movement.
 
 
• He was also a writer and founded the newspaper, **"The Punjabee."**
